Method of Attack: Remote code execution via Qt5 platformpluginpath command line argument allowing loading of malicious DLL plugins from remote UNC share; Exploitation of custom URI handlers that do not sanitize command line arguments, enabling remote loading and execution of malicious Qt5 plugins
Attack Vector: Custom URI handler invocation with crafted command line arguments including platformpluginpath pointing to remote UNC share; Clicking on malicious links using custom URI protocols (e.g., malwarebytes://, ciscospark://) that launch vulnerable applications with malicious arguments
